facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 July 2024 a corrective action on TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
